text: The Civic Appointments Committee will conduct interviews and recommend two candidates to City Council for appointment to the Exhibition Place Board of Governors.

City Council on December 13, 14, and 15, 2023, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint the following candidates to the Exhibition Place Board of Governors, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending on December 16, 2027, and until successors are appointed: Malcolm Bromley Aakanksha Verma 2. City Council direct that Confidential Attachments 1 to 6 to the report (October 31, 2023) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Exhibition Place Board.
